newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-FORMER OPEN CHAMPION PIERCE UPSETS LIKHOVTSEVA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FORMER OPEN CHAMPION PIERCE UPSETS LIKHOVTSEVA.

text.p: Former Australian Open champion Mary Pierce of France upset 13th seed Elena Likhovtseva in a tense first round match at the Australian Open on Monday.
Pierce, ranked 22 in the world and on a comeback trail, beat her Russian opponent 3-6 6-2 6-4.
The 1995 Open winner finally clinched a second round berth with her fifth match point.
In a see-sawing finale, Pierce came back from three break points down on her serve at 5-4 to take the match.

Likhovtseva became the second women's seed to fall in the first round following 11th seed Judith Wiesner's defeat at the hands of unseeded Ruxandra Dragomir, the Romanian beating the Austrian 4-6 6-3 10-8.
